messages:
maya: Quick heads-up 1 - I'm preparing a small docs change to clarify SOC2/audit-log language: default retention wording, tenant isolation examples, a redaction hint, and a short JS SDK migration note. Can folks quick-check?

devin: Yep. Proposed retention phrasing?

maya: Draft: "By default, audit logs are retained for 90 days. Extended retention is available via enterprise contracts; Dedicated and Private deployments support operator-configurable retention." Trying to avoid absolutes.

docs-lint-bot: lint: prefer guarded language (e.g., "By default...") and avoid words like "never". Flag: include KMS note for Private.

legal_roy: That phrasing works. Add: "Redwood segregates tenant audit data and does not make tenant logs available to other customers. Logs are encrypted at rest; Private deployments may be configured with customer-managed KMS. Retention and access controls are governed by contract terms." Also recommend a short line telling customers to route legal requests via their account contact.

maya: Added. Draft tenant-scoped wire-format example to copy into the page:```json
{
  "name": "model.invoke",
  "tenant_id": "tenant_42",
  "data": { "prompt": "[REDACTED]" },
  "redacted_fields": ["prompt"],
  "timestamp": "2026-09-01T12:00:00Z"
}
```
Note: include the one-liner that SDKs present camelCase (tenantId) while transport JSON uses snake_case (tenant_id).

devin: Looks good. For the JS SDK migration note: old API `client.audit.log()` -> new `client.audit.emit()` and keys changed. Proposed snippet:```js
// OLD
await client.audit.log({ event: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'tenant_42', payload });
// NEW
await client.audit.emit({ name: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'tenant_42', data: payload });
```
Add: "Search for `.audit.log(` and replace with `.audit.emit(`; update `event -> name`, `payload -> data`."

ops_sam: If you include an HTTP/curl example, put it in an "Operator appendix" with a clear warning. Do not publish internal endpoints in main docs. Example (appendix only):```bash
# operator-only
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.local/v1/audit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"model.invoke","tenant_id":"tenant_42","data":{}}'
```
Add an explicit warning: "Operator-only: do not call these paths from customer apps."

legal_roy: Also add a short developer guidance line: "Customers that include sensitive or PII content in prompts should consider redaction or shorter retention; Redwood will honor contractual retention changes for enterprise agreements." Tag PR with `legal:review` when opened.

maya: Will do. I'll keep the SDK examples prominent, include the wire JSON example, add the redaction hint and the migration checklist, and append the operator curl under a clearly labeled appendix. Opening WIP PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2801 (WIP).

devin: Nit: include one-line copy-paste of `redacted_fields: ["prompt"]` in both JSON and JS examples so implementers can copy it.

maya: Done. I'll ping legal_roy and ops_sam for reviews and add the labels before requesting review. Thanks all! :sparkles:
